description: C3 rows (A,B,C): (1,1,1),(1,2,1),(1,2,2),(2,1,1),(2,1,2),(2,2,1),(3,1,1). Index IX_ABC is (A ASC, B DESC, C ASC), IX_AD is (A DESC, B ASC). For each of IX_ABC with key (1,2,1); IX_ABC with key (1,2); IX_ABC with key (1); IX_ABC with key (2,1); IX_AD with key (2,1); IX_AD with key (2) and each operator = >= > <= <: fresh table-type recordset, set the Index, Seek, read NoMatch, BOF, EOF, A, B and C; MoveNext and read; MovePrevious twice and read. Asks the value-order versus index-order meaning of each operator on a partial key over mixed and leading-descending directions, and the neighbours of the selected row. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
